referenceSources.label: Hotel website: Rooms, Amenities, Policies, Booking terms

decisionFacts.label: 1. Location & neighborhood
decisionFacts.externalStatements: Both booking listings show the same address and neighborhood.
decisionFacts.finding: ✓ AgreeSupports recommendations for guests who want to stay in the French Quarter.

decisionFacts.label: 2. Price range & mandatory fees
decisionFacts.baselineStatement: $35 nightly destination fee, added to the room rate.
decisionFacts.externalStatements: One booking listing describes the rate as including all mandatory property fees, but its displayed breakdown omits this charge.
decisionFacts.finding: ! ConflictingAI could understate the total cost and recommend the hotel for a budget it exceeds.

decisionFacts.label: 3. Room types & occupancy
decisionFacts.baselineStatement: King rooms sleep 2; double-queen rooms sleep 4.
decisionFacts.externalStatements: Both booking listings match the room types and maximum occupancy.
decisionFacts.finding: ✓ AgreeSupports matching the room to the number of guests.

decisionFacts.label: 4. Amenities & availability
decisionFacts.externalStatements: The hotel roundup still lists a rooftop pool as a reason to stay.
decisionFacts.finding: ! Outdated elsewhereAI could recommend a pool that guests will not receive.

decisionFacts.label: 5. Atmosphere & guest fit
decisionFacts.baselineStatement: Small, quiet hotel designed for a relaxed stay.
decisionFacts.externalStatements: The hotel guide and booking descriptions also describe a quiet, intimate setting.
decisionFacts.finding: ✓ Descriptions agreeSupports the same description of guest fit. Whether the stay delivers on it is assessed separately through reviews.

decisionFacts.label: 6. Parking & charges
decisionFacts.externalStatements: The Charleston guide lists complimentary parking.
decisionFacts.finding: ! ConflictingAI could describe parking as free or miscalculate the cost of bringing a car.

decisionFacts.label: 7. Pet policy & charges
decisionFacts.externalStatements: One booking listing says pets are not permitted.
decisionFacts.finding: ! ConflictingAI could exclude the hotel from dog-friendly recommendations.

decisionFacts.label: 8. Accessibility features
decisionFacts.baselineStatement: Accessible rooms available; specific bathroom and access features not described.
decisionFacts.externalStatements: Booking listings say “accessible” without naming the room features.
decisionFacts.finding: ? Not enough to confirmThe sources do not establish which room meets a guest’s specific access needs. Agreement on a vague label is insufficient.

decisionFacts.label: 9. Breakfast & inclusions
decisionFacts.baselineStatement: Breakfast available for an additional charge.
decisionFacts.externalStatements: One booking listing says breakfast is included in every rate.
decisionFacts.finding: ! ConflictingAI could overstate what the stay includes. Specific packages may differ and need to be matched.

decisionFacts.label: 10. Cancellation & booking restrictions
decisionFacts.baselineStatement: Flexible and nonrefundable rates offered; conditions shown during booking.
decisionFacts.externalStatements: A guide says “free cancellation” without specifying a rate or deadline.
decisionFacts.finding: ? Rate conditions unclearAI should not describe every booking as refundable. Conditions must match the selected rate.
